highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 brings the Skia M155 renderer and current HarfBuzz bindings to preview consumers.
highlights_body: It also updates GLES interop and disables RAW and DNG decoding. Test applications that use these image formats or low-level OpenGL interop before adopting the preview.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia M155 and includes the latest upstream servicing fixes.
Updates the low-level GLES interop surface to pass native pointer values directly.
Prevents the bundled decoder from accepting RAW and DNG images in this release line.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the M155 line with the bundled Skia engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 adds upstream M155 fixes, updated HarfBuzz bindings, and low-level graphics interop changes.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library and managed bindings to version 14.4.0.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia M155 engine line.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 2 refreshes the M155 renderer and HarfBuzz bindings.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It also updates low-level GLES interop and disables RAW and DNG image decoding.
